name: org.decentraland.unityuniversalinstancer
description: Clean-room GPU-driven indirect instancing runtime providing the GPUInstancerPro C# surface DCL consumes (GPUICoreAPI / GPUIProfile / GPUIRuntimeSettings / GPUIShaderBindings / GPUIDebuggerCanvas / GPUIPrefabManager / GPUIDetailManager / GPUITreeManager). Registers prototypes with their mesh/material LODs, uploads per-instance transforms into GraphicsBuffers, runs a Burst cull + LOD-selection pass each frame, and submits per-LOD procedural-instanced draws with shadow casting via Graphics.RenderMeshPrimitives. Paired with org.decentraland.instancing-assets, both versionDefines together raise GPUI_PRO_PRESENT.
